name: Vercel
label: Vercel REST API
description: Vercel REST API via OfficialApiNode. Docs: https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api. Operations: deploy_create, deploy_get, deploy_list, deploy_cancel, deploy_delete, project_get, project_create, env_set, domain_get, listen. Auth secret token is instance config only (never on INPUT, never logged). listen/trigger are kind:ingress — use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Failures are output.error. JDK HTTP, official API only.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets here. Path params such as id match api_spec.json placeholders.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official API call to run. EXACT values: deploy_create | deploy_get | deploy_list | deploy_cancel | deploy_delete | project_get | project_create | env_set | domain_get | listen. Prefer the instance config operation select. listen/trigger are ingress: they do not call HTTP — use a BPMN message event. Example: 'deploy_create'.

schema.label: id
schema.description: Deployment id.

schema.label: idOrName
schema.description: Project id or name.

schema.label: domain
schema.description: Domain name.

schema.label: teamId
schema.description: Overrides config teamId.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Project name for deploy_create (required) and project_create (required). Example: marketing-site.

schema.label: project
schema.description: Request-body parameter `project` for operation: deploy_create.

schema.label: gitSource
schema.description: Git source for deploy_create as a JSON object; use this or files. Example: {"type":"github","repoId":"123456","ref":"main"}.

schema.label: files
schema.description:
Inline files for deploy_create when no gitSource is set: list of {file, data} (or {file, sha, size} for pre-uploaded files). Example: [{"file":"index.html","data":"

Hi

"}].

schema.label: projectId
schema.description: Query-string parameter `projectId` for operation: deploy_list.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Query-string parameter `limit` for operation: deploy_list.

schema.label: framework
schema.description: Request-body parameter `framework` for operation: project_create.

schema.label: key
schema.description: Environment variable name for env_set (required). Example: API_URL.

schema.label: value
schema.description: Environment variable value for env_set (required). Example: https://api.example.com.

schema.label: type
schema.description: Environment variable type for env_set (required). EXACT: plain | encrypted | sensitive | system | secret. Example: encrypted.

schema.label: target
schema.description: deploy_create: production | staging. env_set: target environments as a JSON array string or list, e.g. ["production","preview","development"]. https://vercel.com/docs/rest-api/reference/endpoints/deployments/create-a-new-deployment

schema.label: regions
schema.description: Optional deploy_create region codes. Example: ["iad1"].

schema.label: gitBranch
schema.description: env_set: preview-branch name when type is sensitive/encrypted and the var is branch-scoped. Example: feat-x.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status:ok, http_status, data}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Exact ok on HTTP 2xx. Absent on failure.

schema.label: HTTP Status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or raw text.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official API operation. EXACT: deploy_create, deploy_get, deploy_list, deploy_cancel, deploy_delete, project_get, project_create, env_set, domain_get, listen. listen is BPMN ingress, not a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Teamid
configurationParameters.description: Team id query on team-scoped calls.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect + read timeout. Default 25. Keep at or below the daemon stateful budget (~300s).
